description: HELD-OUT TEST set (v3) for the Milestone 19 judge change. Overlay eval/seeded_patches_v3: six NEW deliberate mismatches, mixing CODE-ONLY changes where a config value still agrees with the design (the trap that beat the v1/v2 judge), BEHAVIOURAL changes (a halved armor, a reversed comparison) and config-only changes. Written BEFORE the per-source judge was implemented; the judge was developed on v1 and v2, which are spent, and this set is run once per variant. By the AI assistant, not an independent party. `unsupported` claims are half far off-topic, half on-topic near-misses.

seeded_changes.change: MIN_DAMAGE is 2; the design says no hit deals less than 1 (config minimum_damage still says 1). CODE-ONLY: the config agrees with the design.
apply_poison refreshes the duration to 8.0 seconds; the design says 5 (config poison_duration_sec still says 5). CODE-ONLY.
take_damage subtracts armor / 2; the design says armor is subtracted flat. BEHAVIOURAL.
find_target keeps the FARTHEST enemy (comparison reversed); the design says the Arrow Tower fires at the closest. BEHAVIOURAL, one character.
boss_leak_penalty is 3; the design says a leaked boss costs 5 lives.

claims.claim: No hit ever deals less than 1 damage.
Applying Poison again refreshes its duration to 5 seconds.
Armor is subtracted flat from every hit.
The Arrow Tower fires at the closest enemy.
Clearing a wave without leaking any enemy grants a flawless bonus of 25 gold.
If a Shardlord leaks it costs the player 5 lives instead of 1.
No more than 12 towers can be built at once.
Every run begins with 20 lives.
Chill slows enemies by 30 percent.
Towers cannot be upgraded beyond level 3.
A boss enrages when its health falls below 25 percent.
Wraiths cannot be slowed by Chill.
The cost of an upgrade grows with the level reached.
The Shardlord is treated as a boss because it has at least 5000 health.
The game has a cooperative two-player mode.
Sound effects can be muted in a settings menu.
Towers have unlockable cosmetic skins.
The enemy path is randomised at the start of every run.
Burn stops Poison from ticking.
Runners take extra damage from Frost Towers.
Selling a tower during a wave gives a smaller refund.
Cannon shells stun the enemies they hit.
